title: Launches rocket family → fleet launcher mapping (PRD-020 / RFC-023)
description: Manual mapping from source-side rocket family/config strings (LL2 / agency / GCAT) to the canonical Orrery fleet launcher ids used to populate orrery_launcher_ref on each launch entry.

families.description: Default mapping by rocket_family string → fleet launcher id.

config_exceptions.description: Override by specific rocket_config_name when the family default isn't right.
